notes_md:
# exp0008 — deotte-plus-lgbm-m4

**Parent:** exp0001 (CV 0.94333 ± 0.00070)

**Hypothesis:** Adding a LightGBM model (`m4`, num_leaves=63, lr=0.05, early stopping 100) trained on the
m1 feature matrix (raw + helpers + freq counts, no recipe column, no base_margin) as a 4th equal-weight
member of the Deotte XGB blend lifts CV by >= 0.0001. m1/m2/m3 are all XGBoost on the same matrix
(0.94310 / 0.94317 / 0.94309) and ~0.99 correlated; a second tree library gives decorrelated errors.

**Change:** new `--lgbm` flag on `train --strategy deotte`; `run_cv` trains `DeotteVariant.LGBM` and
blends all trained variants with equal weights; `predict_proba` reads the variant list from `cv.json`.
XGB params, folds (5, seed 42), recipe, base_margin and `--freq` unchanged.
